verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise page claims "Programmatic queries via API" with batch processing, and GSK connects through a custom API. However, no public API reference or OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). The only publicly documented programmatic interface is the MCP endpoint at mcp.undermind.ai, with its tools described on the /mcp page. missing for 10: public API reference documentation, an OpenAPI spec or endpoint/auth docs, self-serve (non-enterprise) API access, independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Programmatic queries via API ... Batch processing for high-volume research work
GSK’s internal AI platform also connects programmatically to Undermind via a custom API
